summary: The ordered case split is exhaustive, every invoked predecessor fact has all of its hypotheses satisfied, the proposed witnesses lie in the required slices, and the residual case correctly relabels the outer slices and applies the residual-domain and continuous-threshold facts with B=A_1, b=a_1, and g_B=g_1.
